name: Mary Ludwig Hays
role: Camp follower with the Pennsylvania artillery; served her husband's gun at Monmouth
portrayal: The documented core of the 'Molly Pitcher' legend, presented as herself: carrying water to the guns in 100-degree heat, taking her husband William's place at the piece when he collapsed. Pennsylvania later granted her a veteran's pension 'for services rendered' — the state's own paper trail.

documented_beats.event: Serves the gun through the Perrine Ridge cannonade at Monmouth

codex_notes: The codex entry separates the woman from the composite legend ('Molly Pitcher' folds in Margaret Corbin of Fort Washington and others) per docs/08 myth-flag policy — the legend is discussed, the person is portrayed.
